newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet falls on full-yr earnings, outlook.
newsitem.headline: Valmet falls on full-yr earnings, outlook.

text.p: Shares in Finnish paper machine maker Valmet Oy fell on Wednesday on a below-forecast Jan-April profit and as its full-year earnings outlook seemed slightly weaker than it had stated earlier, brokers said.
At 1630/1330 GMT, Valmet traded at 90.30 markka, down 3.50 markka or 3.7 percent in lively 34 million markka volume.
"Valmet has earlier said its full year result would reach last years level but now it said it may not quite do that," one broker said, adding the market saw this as a negative signal.
Brokers said they did not expect Valmet to fall below 90 markka. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, news@reuters.fi
